_doc: Machine-readable QA artifact index. Future sessions read this first to enumerate every QA artifact, when each was last refreshed, and what's required before a release. CLAUDE.md prose mirrors this; this JSON is the source of truth.

required: release_version field in report matches plugin VERSION constant

self_check_command.what_it_does: Reads docs/qa/qa-config.json + AGENT_SMOKE_RUNBOOK.md, dispatches a Sonnet sub-agent to walk every section + execute every authored journey, writes report to docs/qa/.last-smoke-pass.json, returns failures + Basecamp drafts. Opus re-verifies before filing cards.

runbook.purpose: Customer contracts, A-G sections (fresh install, upgrade, core flows, regression guards, Pro extensions, cross-browser, post-release monitoring).

supplements_runbook.purpose: Pro-only ops (S1-S12 — version lockstep, license, dependency guard, INV-12, coupling, retention, HMAC, namespace, REST gating, toggle isolation).

journeys.purpose: Executable end-to-end flows. Each is a self-contained markdown file an agent runs via Playwright + WP-CLI + curl + mysql_query. Returns PASS/FAIL with exact step + likely_files for triage.

wppqa_baseline.purpose: Static-analysis bug finder (plugin-dev-rules, REST↔JS contract, wiring completeness). Run BEFORE manifest refresh on every onboarding pass.

maintenance_loop._doc: What MUST happen on each event so QA self-grows.
on_customer_visible_bug_fix: Add a row to docs/qa/AGENT_SMOKE_RUNBOOK.md Section D in the same PR
Write a regression journey at audit/journeys/regression/<descriptor>.md in the same PR
Reference the journey in CLAUDE.md 'Customer journeys' table
Reference the bug card # in the journey's frontmatter `covers:` field
on_new_feature: Add a row to docs/qa/AGENT_SMOKE_RUNBOOK.md Section C (or E for Pro) with the customer contract
Write a customer/ or admin/ journey covering the happy path + 1 negative test
Update the manifest via /wp-plugin-onboard --refresh after the feature lands
on_release_tag: Verify report shows release_version matches plugin VERSION
Verify failures[] and debug_log_issues[] are empty
bin/build-release.sh refuses to package without a green report
Tag and push (release script handles the rest)
on_manifest_refresh: Compare static_analysis counts against latest wppqa baseline
Update CLAUDE.md READ-FIRST line if counts changed substantially
If any new fired hook is added without a documented consumer, add to plan/ as scope question
on_two_clean_releases_of_a_d_row: Graduate the regression journey from audit/journeys/regression/ into audit/journeys/customer/ or admin/
Move the runbook D row into the matching C/E row
Bump the journey's priority from `high` to the matching feature's priority

discovery_for_new_sessions._doc: What a fresh Claude Code session should read FIRST when it cd's into this plugin.
order: audit/manifest.summary.json (≤3 KB index of plugin shape)
CLAUDE.md QA Pipeline section (release gate + maintenance loop)
